preserveSays.line: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
You give A person, maybe 60s, with a shaved head 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You give A man, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
You give Tashi 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
★ IDENTIFIED: Bracken Fiddlehead. Bracken. Coiled fiddleheads opening into triangle fronds. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Bracken Fiddlehead too.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Bracken Fiddlehead — named and noted.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 12 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
👂 Overheard — A person, maybe 60s, with a shaved head: "If we rotate the watch, nobody pulls two nights running. Fair's fair."
📓 Journal: Sanne taught the person in their 50s Food Preservation.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👁 Wary. Ears always tracking. Get close before it knows you're there.
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
🍽️ Naran carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
👂 Overheard — Stella: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
Otis looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
SYSTEM: Quest protocol integrated. Objectives will appear.
🍽️ Sanne eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
"Earned, not given. You did the work — we just wrote it down."
🌿 Bracken Fiddlehead — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Bracken Fiddlehead: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dead Phone
Cracked screen, 2% forever. The last text, unsent: 'call when you can.' It was from Dawei — your brother. You have carried the unsent message for years. Maybe he is still out there.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Your brother — last known heading west. Someone, somewhere, might have seen him.
🧵 THE THREAD HOME — Seek Dawei Tan — your brother, Taken at the Scattering. The Dead Phone still says their name.
📓 Codex: Stella taught Marco Food Preservation.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
(425 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
👂 Overheard — Otis: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."
🍽️ Elif weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."
🍽️ Marco carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
(438 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

Marco leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Loud-Eyes. Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Loud-Eyes: Strike the head as it coils. When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Strike the head as it coils — When the coils start to wrap, don't pull away — strike the head and eyes. It will release to protect them. On land it is slow and heavy; it needs the water to be the Empress. Never let it get a second wrap.
Investigate and the morning is gone — tracking them costs a full day-part. Bar the door and you learn nothing. Your call.
🍽️ Stella eyes the groaning pantry shelves and packs light today. "No point hauling what'll rot. Mending the nets instead."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.

◈ SYSTEM: "The long game, little hoarders. A GRANARY. Stockpile 20,000 kcal, 500 wood and 2,000 kcal of PRESERVED food — food that WAITS. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The audience finds delayed gratification EXOTIC. So do stomachs, we are told."
(258 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
🗣️ Marco to Pedro, by the fire: "The granary wants food that WAITS — 0 of 2,000 kcal preserved. Smoke it, dry it, render it. The fresh stuff doesn't count."
🍽️ Aria taps the pantry's fullest jar. "More than we can eat before it turns. Rendering fat instead — the lamps won't fill themselves."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
✨ Trail Eyes — You notice tracks without trying. (tier 1)

Naran leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Rut King. Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
📓 Codex: Counter: Give it a tree — His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
★ Deeper knowledge: Groundnut. Parts: the tubers. Cook well — raw causes stomach trouble. Exceptional protein. (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: protein-rich tubers — cook thoroughly.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🍲 Stella cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Stella worked the smoke racks too — 1 batch preserved (~3200 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
🛖 Raised bins, sealed lids, clay and cool dark. The granary stands full of food that waits — smoked, dried, rendered, patient. Whatever comes, Haven eats a while longer.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🍲 Stella cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Stella worked the smoke racks too — 3 batches preserved (~3090 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
The village threw out spoiled stores: Expedition haul. Kairat mutters: "Should've smoked that. Fresh stuff keeps a day or two on the shelf — the smoke rack is right there." (pantry)

📺 "But real talk? The next act needs a BIGGER STAGE. I can't stage it with ONE fire — there's not enough of you to REFLECT, you feel me? Get me STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread. Rack up the kills, season your alliances, or feast like legends. Make it worth escalating."
(366 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

Tashi leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Big Loud. Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Big Loud: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Hit it after it drinks — It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan.
🍽️ Naran carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🍲 Marco cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Marco worked the smoke racks too — 4 batches preserved (~3149 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
The village threw out spoiled stores: 35 Chickweed. (pantry)

🔥 The fire settles. Elif has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Kairat breathes "So it bleeds." Naran breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🍲 Marco cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Marco worked the smoke racks too — 1 batch preserved (~3172 kcal, keeps a couple of weeks).
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The village threw out spoiled stores: 47 Blackberry, 31 Blackberry, 5 Foraged food. (pantry)
(435 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)

🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Ad Break is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.

📓 Codex: you've SEEN Fusion Reactor now. The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
🍲 Marco cooked for the haven — meals stretched. Marco worked the smoke racks too — 3 batches preserved (~1665 kcal, keeps for weeks).
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
🍽️ Kairat carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."

Yuki leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Living Wire. Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Get OUT of the water — When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.

🔥 The fire settles. Stella has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Living Wire — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Naran breathes "So it bleeds." Aria breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
🍽️ Naran carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."

(297 kcal of dried meat and clean water. Nothing traceable.)
